inventory.notes: Changes the Accept-Language value a page can observe on requests from a BrowsingContext with languageOverride set. A single tag prepares to itself; a list now gets q-values as intl.accept_languages does. If the prepared value is empty the header is not set (no fallback). Needs a forward declaration of the static PrepareAcceptLanguages (defined around line 2098 of this file, declared around line 748); that is one extra Mozilla line. The 5 logic lines are at the already-hook limit; moving the if-block into our own helper would make it a one-liner.
